title: Breakfast and Lunch
text:
Every morning, I eat breakfast at home. I like bread with butter and a glass of milk. My brother likes eggs. We eat at seven o'clock.

At lunch, we eat at school. The soup is hot and the rice is good. After school, we have a snack. I like apples.

questions.text: What does the narrator eat for breakfast?
Where do the people in the passage eat lunch?
What can we infer about the narrator's family meals?
options: They have a regular routine for meals

questions.text: Why does the narrator probably want a snack after school?
options: The narrator is hungry after a long day at school
The narrator never eats at home
The narrator is at a restaurant

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
a soft yellow food made from milk, eaten on bread
the meal eaten in the middle of the day
a small amount of food eaten between main meals

paragraph_translations: Todas las mañanas, desayuno en casa. Me gusta el pan con mantequilla y un vaso de leche. A mi hermano le gustan los huevos. Comemos a las siete en punto.
A la hora del almuerzo, comemos en la escuela. La sopa está caliente y el arroz es bueno. Después de la escuela, comemos una merienda. Me gustan las manzanas.
